Definition: from G4784; a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with:--agreement.
BiblicalUsage: Paul asks what agreement the temple of God has with idols, for we are the temple of the living God, and God has said He will dwell in them and walk in them. The temple cannot agree with idols because God lives in it, and agreement with idols would evict its tenant.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the temple of God has no agreement with idols, and I believe my body, His temple, must keep the same separation.
